description.en: Jinhsi is an Spectro character typically used as an on-field main DPS. Jinhsi specializes in Resonance Skill DMG. With a wide attack range, excellent targeting, and high burst potential, she boasts both high floor and high ceiling performance.

substatsPriority.en: Crit Rate% / Crit DMG% > Resonance Skill DMG% > ATK% > Energy Regen%

note.en: Note: Target around 115% - 120% Energy Regen for smooth combat rotations.

substatsPriority.en: Crit Rate% / Crit DMG% > Resonance Skill DMG% > ATK% > Energy Regen%

note.en: Note: Target around 115% - 120% Energy Regen for smooth combat rotations.

description.en: When casting Basic Attack "Incarnation - Basic Attack" or Resonance Skill Crescent Divinity, Jinhsi gains one stack of Herald of Revival, stacking up to 4 times and lasting for 6s. When casting Resonance Skill Illuminous Epiphany, Jinhsi consumes all stacks of Herald of Revival. Each stack increases the damage of Resonance Skill Illuminous Epiphany by 20%.
Jinhsi restores 50 Incandescence while staying out of combat for more than 4s. This effect can only be triggered 1 time(s) every 4s.

Jinhsi gains one stack of Immortal's Descendancy after casting Intro Skill Loong's Halo. Each stack of Immortal's Descendancy increases Jinhsi's ATK by 25%, stacking up to 2 time(s) and lasting for 20s.
When Jinhsi casts Resonance Liberation Purge of Light or Resonance Skill Illuminous Epiphany, all nearby Resonators on the team gain 20% Attribute DMG Bonus for 20s.
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Purge of Light is increased by 120%.
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Illuminous Epiphany is increased by 45% and the additional DMG Multiplier gained by consuming Incandescence is increased by 45%.

guideDetails.en: Jinhsi is a highly explosive burst DPS whose main damage comes from her Forte Circuit. Coordinate with sub-DPS units (like Yinlin or Yuanwu) who can deal coordinated attacks to quickly build Jinhsi's Forte Circuit stacks.

description.en: A former patroller of the Jinzhou Security Department, working under the cover of secrecy to hunt down the Fractsidus. Yinlin serves as an exceptional off-field Sub-DPS who inflicts coordinated Electro damage and amplifies team Ultimate and Electro damage output.

en: Calcharo or Xiangli Yao (Main Carry)

description.en: Magnetic Roar and Lightning Execution deal 70% extra damage.
Electromagnetic Blast recovers an additional 5 Judgement Points and 5 Resonance Energy on hit.
Judgment Strike damage multiplier increased by 55%.
When Judgment Strike hits, team ATK is increased by 20% for 12 seconds.
Resonance Liberation deals 100% extra damage to targets affected by marks.
For 30s after casting Resonance Liberation, basic attacks trigger Furious Thunder dealing massive Electro damage.

guideDetails.en: Yinlin is an exceptional off-field Sub-DPS who provides massive Electro DMG amplification and coordinated attacks. Trigger her Forte Gauge completely to apply Sinner's Mark, and swap-cancel her heavy attacks to maximize team rotation speed.

description.en: A bright and energetic patroller of Jinzhou, who is always ready to lend a hand. Chixia functions as a powerful ranged Fusion DPS, dealing rapid fire damage through her specialized pistols and continuous Daka-Daka Resonance Skill firing mode.

substatsPriority.en: Crit Rate% / Crit DMG% > Resonance Skill DMG% > ATK% > Basic Attack DMG%

note.en: Note: Chixia does not require high Energy Regen, making offensive substats the primary goal.

substatsPriority.en: Crit Rate% / Crit DMG% > Resonance Skill DMG% > ATK% > Basic Attack DMG%

note.en: Note: Chixia does not require high Energy Regen, making offensive substats the primary goal.

description.en: Chixia's Resonance Skill ("Boom Boom" hits) will always be a Critical Hit.
During Resonance Liberation, for every target defeated, Chixia recovers 5 Resonance Energy (up to 20 per Liberation).
Resonance Liberation deals 40% more damage to targets with HP below 50%.
Resonance Liberation grants 60 "Thermobaric Bullets" and immediately resets the cooldown of her Resonance Skill.
When inherent skill ("Numbingly Spicy!") reaches max stacks, her ATK is increased by 30%.
Resonance Skill increases the Basic Attack DMG Bonus of all team members by 25% for 15 seconds.

guideDetails.en: Chixia is a high-firepower Fusion DPS who relies heavily on her continuous Resonance Skill attacks. Focus on utilizing her rapid-fire state and quickly swap to off-field supports who can boost her Fusion damage.

description.en: Counselor to the Jinzhou Magistrate and mentor to Jinhsi. Possessing a clever mind and a graceful demeanor, Changli commands the battlefield as a powerful Fusion Carry, capable of acting as both a primary Main DPS or a high-multiplier Sub-DPS that buffs incoming Fusion Resonators.

substatsPriority.en: Crit Rate% / Crit DMG% > Resonance Skill DMG% > ATK% > Energy Regen%

note.en: Note: Target around 120% Energy Regen to ensure smooth skill/ult sequencing.

en: Encore or Chixia (Main Carry)
Sanhua (ATK Speed Buff Support)

description.en: Resonance Skill and Heavy Attack increase her DMG dealt by 10% and grant resistance to interruption.
Obtaining a stack of Enflamement increases Changli's Crit Rate by 25% for 8 seconds.
Resonance Liberation DMG is increased by 80%.
After casting her Intro Skill, all team members' ATK is increased by 20% for 30 seconds.
Heavy Attack base damage multiplier is increased by 50% and its DMG dealt is increased by 50%.
Resonance Skill, Heavy Attack, and Resonance Liberation ignore an additional 40% of the target's DEF.

guideDetails.en: Changli excels as a high-burst Fusion Carry who can act as both a primary Main DPS and a Sub-DPS. Accumulate Enflamement stacks through her skills to unleash her high-multiplier Heavy Attacks, and leverage her Fusion damage buff for teammates.

description.en: The mysterious and divine guardian of the Black Shores, tethered directly to the vital systems of the island. Shorekeeper represents a top-tier support unit, providing team-wide healing, Crit Rate/Crit DMG scaling buffers, and crucial utility through her starlight and butterfly manifestations.

substatsPriority.en: Energy Regen% > HP% > Crit Rate% (until 20%) > Flat HP

note.en: Note: Target 250%+ Energy Regen and at least 20% Crit Rate to fully optimize her passive kit buffers.

substatsPriority.en: Energy Regen% > HP% > Crit Rate% (until 20%) > Flat HP

note.en: Note: Target 250%+ Energy Regen and at least 20% Crit Rate to fully optimize her passive kit buffers.

en: Jinhsi or Jiyan (Main Carry)
Yinlin or Sanhua (Sub-DPS / Buffer)

description.en: Increases the radius of Stellarealms by 150% and their duration by 10 seconds. Intro Skill no longer ends Stellarealm prematurely.
The Outer Stellarealm now grants a 40% ATK Bonus to team members inside it.
Casting Resonance Liberation grants an additional 20 Concerto Energy (once every 25 seconds).
Increases the Healing Bonus of her Resonance Skill by 70%.
Increases the pulling effect range of her Basic Attack 3 by 50% and her Forte Heavy Attack (Illation) by 30%.
Multiplicatively increases base damage multiplier of Intro Skill by 42% and increases Crit DMG by 500%.

guideDetails.en: Shorekeeper is a premier support unit providing team-wide healing and massive Crit Rate/Crit DMG scaling buffs. Always cast her Resonance Liberation to establish the Stellarealm domain and keep her Energy Regen above 250%.

description.en: The commander of the Midnight Rangers in Jinzhou, wielding his broadblade with wind-carving swiftness and summoning the Qingloong. Jiyan acts as a premier Aero Main DPS, converting his attacks into heavy-damage Lance strikes during his Resonance Liberation.

substatsPriority.en: Crit Rate% / Crit DMG% > Heavy Attack DMG% > ATK% > Energy Regen%

note.en: Note: Aim for 120% - 130% Energy Regen to ensure smooth ultimate uptime.

substatsPriority.en: Crit Rate% / Crit DMG% > Heavy Attack DMG% > ATK% > Energy Regen%

note.en: Note: Aim for 120% - 130% Energy Regen to ensure smooth ultimate uptime.

en: Mortefi (Heavy ATK Amp Sub-DPS)

description.en: Resonance Skill Windqueller can be cast 1 more time. The active time of the skill is increased by 1 second.
When casting Intro Skill Tactical Strike, Jiyan recovers 30 Resolve and increases ATK by 28% for 15 seconds.
When casting Resonance Liberation Emerald Storm or Intro Skill Tactical Strike, increases Crit Rate by 16% and Crit DMG by 32% for 8 seconds.
When casting Resonance Liberation, increases all team members' Heavy Attack DMG by 25% for 30 seconds.
Outro Skill damage multiplier is increased by 120%. Jiyan's attacks ignore 15% of the target's DEF.
Increases the damage multiplier of Jiyan's attacks in Qingloong state by an additional 120%.

guideDetails.en: Jiyan is a highly consistent Aero Main DPS. Pair him with Mortefi to gain a massive Heavy Attack DMG boost from Mortefi's Outro Skill, and make sure to swap to Jiyan when his concerto energy is full to activate his high-impact entry attacks.

description.en: A bodyguard to the Magistrate of Jinzhou, quiet and reserved, keeping her emotions hidden. Sanhua serves as a fast-paced Glacio Sub-DPS, providing outstanding basic attack damage amplification and exceptionally rapid Concerto accumulation.

substatsPriority.en: Crit Rate% / Crit DMG% > Energy Regen% > ATK% > Resonance Skill DMG%

note.en: Note: Focus on high Energy Regen to spam her Ultimate and maintain the Moonlit Clouds buff rotation.

en: Encore or Rover (Havoc) (Main Carry)
Sanhua (Sub-DPS / Basic ATK Amp)

description.en: Basic Attack 5 increases Sanhua's Crit Rate by 15% for 15 seconds.
Resonance Skill cooldown is reduced by 20% and Stamina consumption is reduced by 15%.
Sanhua's damage against targets with HP below 50% is increased by 35%.
Casting Resonance Liberation recovers 10 Resonance Energy and increases Heavy Attack DMG by 120% for 5 seconds.
Forte Circuit Ice Burst critical damage is increased by 100%.
Upon detonating Ice Thorns or Glaciers, increases all team members' ATK by 20% for 20 seconds.

guideDetails.en: Sanhua is an incredibly fast Sub-DPS focused on basic attack amplification and speedy rotation. Master her Forte gauge timing (detonating ice glaciers with heavy attacks) to maximize her off-field damage contribution.

description.en: The mysterious protagonist of Solaris-3, awakening their slumbering Havoc powers. Wielding their dark sword, Rover (Havoc) acts as a highly explosive Main DPS, dealing devastating area damage through their Dark Surge state and ultimate.

substatsPriority.en: Crit Rate% / Crit DMG% > Resonance Liberation DMG% > ATK% > Resonance Skill DMG%

note.en: Note: Focus on building high Crit Rate/DMG to fully capitalize on her high-scaling multipliers.

substatsPriority.en: Crit Rate% / Crit DMG% > Resonance Liberation DMG% > ATK% > Resonance Skill DMG%

note.en: Note: Focus on building high Crit Rate/DMG to fully capitalize on her high-scaling multipliers.

description.en: Increases Crit Rate of Resonance Skill by 15% for 6s when Rover's HP is above 60%.
Increases Havoc DMG by 20% when Rover's HP is below 60%.
Forte Circuit Heavy Attack Devastation damage multiplier increased by 50%.
Resonance Liberation ignores 20% of the target's DEF.
Rover recovers 20% HP on casting Resonance Liberation if HP is below 50%.
Increases Rover's ATK by 25% for 15s after casting Resonance Liberation.

guideDetails.en: Rover (Havoc) is an exceptional F2P main damage dealer. Her burst capability during her Forte Circuit state (Dark Surge) and the massive multipliers on her Resonance Liberation make her highly competitive. Always pair her with Danjin to receive a 23% Havoc DMG Amplification boost from Danjin's Outro Skill.
